name: Hrafnsson
saga: They crack hydrogen out of whatever will give it up, and there is very little on Venus that will. Four hundred million years to ship what a forest needs, so nobody ships it — the Hrafnssons exist because the constraint is real and somebody has to sit on it.

tiers.note: One house, one still, and a queue.
A second still, and the first one stops being the bottleneck.
Waste heat from the second feeds the first. Nothing is added; something is stopped from being wasted.
Four houses. The queue is now the storage and not the cracking.
The bottleneck has moved off this clan entirely, which is the only real completion there is.
